configuration.defaultValue:
Analyze the content.
If it is a single word or a short compound word, respond in this JSON format:
{
  "type": "word",
  "word": "original word",
  "ipa": "IPA pronunciation",
  "etymology": "origin",
  "rootAnalysis": "roots",
  "collocations": "list of collocations formatted as a markdown list",
  "memoryAids": "memory aid",
  "commonConfusions": "confusing words formatted as a markdown list"
}
If it is a sentence or a phrase, respond in this JSON format:
{
  "type": "sentence",
  "original": "original text",
  "translation": "translated text",
  "grammarNotes": "brief grammar analysis or key points",
  "alternatives": ["alternative translation 1", "alternative translation 2"]
}
IMPORTANT: You MUST wrap your response in a markdown code block like this:
```json
{ ... }
```

description.en: Convert the selected image to SVG on-device using the defaults in extension settings.
description.zh: 按扩展设置中的默认参数，在本地把选中图片转成 SVG。

description.en: Lower = bigger flat color blocks, easier to edit, less like the photo. Higher = closer to the original, but more pieces.
description.zh: 调低：色块更大、更好改，但会更“海报化”。调高：更接近原图，但形状会变多、文件也更大。

description.en: The picture is shrunk to this longest-edge size before tracing. Higher looks sharper and follows edges better, but is slower and makes a larger SVG.
description.zh: 转换前先把图缩到这个最长边。数字越大：边缘越准、越细腻，但更慢、SVG 也更大。数字越小：更快更干净，但容易变糊、丢细节。

description.en: 1 disables area-based speckle removal. Color quantization and edge smoothing still apply. Higher values merge small regions into adjacent shapes; isolated specks may be removed. Transparent holes are preserved.
description.zh: 1 不按面积清除小色块，仍会进行分色和平滑。调高后小色块会并入相邻图形，孤立杂点可能被移除；真实透明孔洞会保留。

description.en: Smooth curves for illustrations, polygons for angular art, or exact pixel boundaries for pixel art.
description.zh: 插画使用平滑曲线，几何图形可选折线，像素画可保留像素边界。

description.en: Stacked completes covered opaque regions for easier editing. Cutout keeps separate adjacent regions. Both preserve transparent holes.
description.zh: 叠放模式补全被不透明图形覆盖的底层区域，便于单独编辑；拼合模式保留各区域边界。两种模式均保留透明孔洞。

description.en: Finer fitting preserves more contour detail; simpler fitting reduces edit points and file size.
description.zh: 精细拟合保留更多轮廓细节，简洁拟合减少编辑节点和文件大小。

description.en: Recognize simple linear and radial gradients as editable fills. Complex shading stays as color regions. Pixel boundaries always use solid colors.
description.zh: 将简单线性和径向渐变识别为可编辑填充，复杂明暗仍保留为色块；像素边界模式始终使用纯色色块。

description.en: Merge small adjacent regions only when their colors and opacity are close. Editable keeps more shading; Minimal gives fewer shapes but a flatter look. Faithful preserves the previous region detail. Pixel edges always stay exact.
description.zh: 只合并颜色与透明度接近的相邻小色块。便于编辑档保留较多明暗；极简档图形更少，但画面更平；精细档保留原来的色块细节。像素边界模式始终保留原样。

description.en: Group connected colors and nearby small parts into object candidates; repeated silhouettes remain separate objects within a collection. Touching or overlapping objects may still need manual adjustment.
description.zh: 将相连色块和归属明显的小部件组成对象候选，相似图形保留为集合中的独立对象。相接或重叠的图形仍可能需要手动调整。

description.zh: 转好的 SVG 存到哪里。留空的话，第一次运行会让你选一次文件夹，之后都用它。
